definitions.explanation: A conjunction pattern meaning "not only A but also B." Indicates that the scope extends beyond A to include B as well. Often paired with ～も at the end of the clause.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧だけでなく⟦{中国語|ちゅうごくご}→中国語：10966_chuugokugo⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{話|はな}せる→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: I can speak not only Japanese but also Chinese.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧だけでなく、⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{手頃|てごろ}→手頃：04068_tegoro⟧だ。
examples.english: This restaurant not only tastes good but is also reasonably priced.

examples.japanese: ⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧だけでなく、⟦{精神的|せいしんてき}→精神的：05851_seishinteki⟧な⟦ストレス→ストレス：03827_sutoresu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{解消|かいしょう}→解消：14143_kaishou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{役立|やくだ}つ→役立つ：03168_yakudatsu⟧。
examples.english: Exercise is not only good for the body but also helps relieve mental stress.

notes:
～だけでなく means "not only A but also B." It is one of the most commonly used conjunction patterns for expanding the scope of a statement.

COMMON PATTERNS:
A + だけでなく + B + ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧
The B clause typically ends with ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ to emphasize the addition.

CONNECTION FORMS:
- After nouns: ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧だけでなく
- After i-adjectives: ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧だけでなく
- After na-adjectives: ⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧なだけでなく
- After verbs: ⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧だけでなく

VARIATIONS (FORMAL → CASUAL):
- ～⟦のみ→のみ：06546_nomi⟧ならず (formal/written)
- ～⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧で⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧ (slightly literary)
- ～⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧ (slightly more formal than だけでなく)
- ～だけでなく (standard)
- ～だけじゃなく (casual spoken)

USAGE:
In conversation, ～だけじゃなくて (with て) is also very common.
